entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you with your VeloFit gear today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about a jersey I bought. I think I need to return it, but I find the website so confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly help with that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, um, I guess preference? I think I just got the wrong size. It feels much too tight across my chest, and I'd like to do an exchange if that's possible.
I completely understand, getting the perfect fit is key. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I start with the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Series Jersey, delivered 37 days ago. Let me just confirm the return eligibility.
37 days? Oh dear. Is that too long? I wasn't sure what the rule was.
Not at all. For a standard apparel item like that jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for a different size.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! Thank you so much, I was worried I'd be stuck with it.

Happy to help. I am generating a pre-paid return label and sending it to your email now. Simply print it out, place the original jersey in a mailer, and drop it off. Once the tracking shows it's on its way back to us, we will ship out the replacement. What size did you need?
A Large would be perfect. Thank you, Diana, you've made this so easy.
It's my pleasure. I've put in the exchange for a size Large. You should see that confirmation email along with the return label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
